title: Questions about The Mall World
content: I'm sure to nobodies surprise, I just found this sub-reddit and am processing this shared phenomenon. I too have a reoccurring dream world with a mall, a school, an airport, you know. I have been reading the posts and even checked out the survey on the topic, and I once again have found myself with more questions than answers. Some things I wish to state based off the survey are that I grew up Christian and now align much more with spirituality. Both me and my mothers lineage experience 'prophetic dreams', in which I have now had mixed in with my reoccurring dreams. The last thing I want to mention is that I am autistic, have PTSD, which I see is also a common theme here. Now, here are my questions. First (to get it out of the way), are any of you familiar with "The Checkered Mall"? In one of my most recent dreams my mother told me she really wanted to visit it, and I have been looking for the right place to ask about this. Second, do any of you have stories about visiting a store in your dream mall and then later in life visiting that same store in real life? If so, I would love to hear them. Third, what kind of significance does the mall hold for you? I feel like the mall means so many different things to so many different people, and I wonder if anybody else here also has a above average fascination with them. Thank you for taking the time to read my post, and shout out to the community around this experience.
